sites.enforcement_snippet:
if current_time > coupon.expires_at:
    raise ExpiredCouponError(f"Coupon {coupon.code} expired at {coupon.expires_at}")

domain_notes: apply_coupon rejects a coupon whose expiry is before current_time, guarded by a single datetime comparison. Both existing tests supply a current_time (2026) well before the coupon expiry (2030); neither supplies an expired coupon, so the rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected apply_coupon because its expiry comparison is the sole enforcement and no test supplies an expired coupon.
